direction: Making room to notice: a narrow sky opening, the silence after a news bulletin, and overlooked field life. Distinct spatial scales and media support memory, political grief and attention. Preserve the existing bespoke date-gift illustration for724; do not assign the unlisted727 source. New interpretation, not a historical editorial theme.

items.title: A little room for sky
items.rationale: Selfie moves through memory, constriction and departure; the small glimpse of sky offers breathing room. Avoid a phone, a literal magic carpet, funeral spectacle or a biographical figure.

review.notes: Normal-size review: the cool sky opening reads first against a quiet warm interior. Wall planes, top light and curtain gravity are coherent; no invented person or phone narrows the poem. The graphite and wash remain sparse in object count. The opening is broader than a literal finger-width glimpse, but still a small release within the composition and retains the emotional anchor.

items.alt: A narrow blue sky opening lights pale interior walls beside the edge of a light cotton curtain.

items.title: After the bulletin
items.rationale: Wasted Penance places public war rhetoric against private fear and waiting. Focus on the room after the news, leaving violence and patriotism in the words rather than making them a spectacle.

review.notes: Normal-size review: the unlit radio and folded sheet establish the pause after news without illustrating violence. Table contact, handle attachment and soft side light remain plausible. Large ordinary wall space permits quiet; the grille is more resolved than the initial sketch preference but stays within a painted object study, without labels or brand marks. No correction required.

items.alt: An unlit portable radio and folded paper sit on a plain table below an open expanse of softly painted wall.

items.title: What grows unasked
items.rationale: The field is green reveals hidden interdependent life, then ends with a wish for a mower. Let attention rest on overlooked growth beside a recently cut margin, rather than illustrating every insect or the mower itself.

review.notes: Normal-size review: a lit translucent leaf invites attention among overlapping ordinary growth, while the cut edge is perceptible without a mower emblem. Near stems have selective pencil definition and the distance dissolves. Richer density is intentional for this poem about overlooked complexity and contrasts with the sparse sky/radio pages. No posed creatures, impossible light or documentary claim.

items.alt: One translucent green leaf catches morning light among tangled field growth beside a narrow cut-grass edge.

text_led.rationale: An imperfect mother speaks in her own voice; a generic parent-child picture would idealise the very relationship she complicates.
The persistent questioning and claim to humanity work through lineation; avoid assigning a face, caste or religious emblem.
Leave absence and its shifting wound metaphor unresolved, without an invented romantic scene.
